questions.question: What determines your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?
questions.explanation: Your BAC depends on how much alcohol you drink, how fast you drink it, and your body weight.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle parked, you should:

options.text: Not apply brakes if the vehicle is out of gear.

questions.explanation: Always use the parking brake when you park. You can also chock the wheels if needed.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you will be asked to:

options.text: Explain what you inspect and why.

questions.correctAnswerText: Explain what you inspect and why.
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, you must inspect your whole vehicle. You must tell the examiner what you are checking and why.

questions.question: If a trailer is too high:
questions.explanation: Before coupling a tractor and trailer, check the trailer height. If it is too low, the nose can be damaged. If it is too high, it may not couple correctly.

questions.question: When using stab braking with liquid cargo, you should:

options.text: Apply brakes with about half your normal force.
Apply brakes as hard as possible without locking the wheels.
Push the brakes fully until the wheels lock. Release until the wheels roll again. Repeat.

questions.correctAnswerText: Push the brakes fully until the wheels lock. Release until the wheels roll again. Repeat.
questions.explanation: Stab braking means fully pressing the brakes until they lock. Then release them until the wheels start rolling. Repeat this process.

questions.question: When putting out an electrical fire, you should:
questions.explanation: Use a B:C extinguisher on electrical fires and burning liquids. Do not use water on electrical fires.

questions.question: When driving in winter, what needs extra attention during a pre-trip inspection?
questions.explanation: In winter, check coolant level and antifreeze amount, defrosting and heating equipment, wiper blades and windshield washer, tires and chains, lights and reflectors, windows and mirrors, handholds and steps, radiator shutters, and the exhaust system.

questions.question: Before a trip, how can you check that air reaches all trailers?

options.text: Check for moving air inside each trailer.
Listen for air at the rear shut-off valve.
Feel for air at the front shut-off valve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Listen for air at the rear shut-off valve.
questions.explanation: Let air pressure build, then send air to the emergency and service lines. Open the shut-off valves on the rear of the last trailer. If air escapes from the rear shut-off valves, air is reaching the whole vehicle.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver confronts you, you should:
questions.explanation: Get out of the way of an aggressive driver when possible. Avoid eye contact, as it may provoke them. Ignore any gestures they make.

questions.question: Shippers package to ____ hazardous materials.
questions.explanation: Shippers package hazardous materials to fully contain them. Vehicles carrying hazardous cargo must have placards to warn about the risk.

questions.question: Which of the following should NOT affect how much liquid you load into a tank?

options.text: How much the liquid will expand during transport

questions.explanation: Safe tank loading depends on liquid expansion during transport, liquid weight, legal weight limits, and load temperature. Driver speed does not affect how much liquid is safe to load.

questions.question: In heavy traffic, the safest driving speed is:

options.text: Slower than other vehicles around you
The same speed as other vehicles around you
Faster than other vehicles around you

questions.correctAnswerText: The same speed as other vehicles around you
questions.explanation: In heavy traffic, drive at the same speed as surrounding vehicles. When two vehicles travel in the same direction at the same speed, they cannot collide.

questions.question: One way to prevent hydroplaning on wet roads is to:

options.text: Keep your tires with good tread depth

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your tires with good tread depth
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning risk increases on wet roads if tire pressure is low or tire tread is worn. If you hydroplane, release the accelerator and push in the clutch to slow down.

questions.question: Antifreeze helps keep an engine running properly:

options.text: Only when it is cold outside
When it is both cold and hot outside

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is both cold and hot outside
questions.explanation: Always maintain proper water and antifreeze levels in your cooling system. Despite its name, antifreeze is important for engine performance in hot weather too.

questions.question: Which is an example of required emergency equipment?
questions.explanation: All commercial vehicles must have proper emergency equipment. This includes spare electrical fuses, three red reflective triangles or three flares, and at least one fire extinguisher that is properly charged.

questions.question: If hazardous materials cargo is on fire, you should:

options.text: Try to put it out with a fire extinguisher
Call emergency personnel and let them handle the fire
Hope the fire goes out on its own

questions.correctAnswerText: Call emergency personnel and let them handle the fire
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials fires require special training and safety gear. Do not try to fight this type of fire yourself unless you have the proper equipment and training.

questions.question: Driving at night is:

options.text: Safer than driving during the day
Just as safe as driving during the day
More dangerous than driving during the day

questions.correctAnswerText: More dangerous than driving during the day
questions.explanation: Night driving is more dangerous because it is harder to see hazards in the dark.

questions.question: Rough acceleration:

options.text: Helps you stay awake on long trips

questions.explanation: Rough acceleration can damage your vehicle. Always accelerate smoothly and gradually.

questions.question: A distracted driver:
questions.explanation: Distracted drivers see road hazards more slowly than focused drivers, or they do not see them at all.

questions.question: Too much air pressure in a tire:
questions.explanation: Never overinflate tires. Check your tire pressure with a gauge during every inspection.
